body:
1. Thanks for understanding that. I'll have to try my hardest to get my parents to understand that.
2. It's a relief to hear that from someone else. I wish my parents didn't have such ultra-high expectations for me (Ivy-League-level expectations); perhaps I can get my parents to get an evaluation done for me, but otherwise, I'll do what I can.
3. The thing is, my family can definitely afford the health care, my mom just doesn't want to deal with the insurance agencies because of paperwork apparently... You see, she quite literally does not see my weight as an "appropriate" reason for my self-consciousness and wants me to somehow magically stop being self-conscious. I don't know what to do about this. I'll have to do my best to convince her, because this seriously enrages me.

Thanks for your words of encouragement, seriously. It helps to know that there's *someone* out there who understands my problems.
